text:
Lazio continued to underline their Serie A title credentials with a comfortable 3-0 home win against Lecce as Gennaro Gattuso’s side remained unbeaten this season and extended their lead at the top of the standings.
Tijjani Noslin scored in each half and Davide Frattesi wrapped up the win in style with a 90th-minute strike as Lazio earned their 10th victory in 12 games to move to 32 points, four ahead of Inter who travel to Atlanta on Sunday. Como are fourth on 26 points after a 2-0 win against Cagliari thanks to goals from Jacobo Ramón and Lucas Da Cunha.
The majority of Lazio fans continue to boycott home matches in protest against the club owner Claudio Lotito, yet the unrest has done little to unsettle Gattuso’s players. “I look at it the other way around,” Frattesi told Dazn when asked about being top of the league. “We’re on 32 points, with eight still to go [for 40 points which usually guarantees survival].”
In Germany, Borussia Dortmund’s Felix Nmecha fired his side to the top of the Bundesliga table as they won 1-0 at bottom side Borussia Mönchengladbach. After Bayern Munich were held to a 1-1 draw at home by Cologne on Friday, Dortmund capitalised to take a two-point lead at the summit.
The home side played far better than their position would suggest, withstanding waves of pressure from the visitors, but Gladbach finally cracked in the 80th minute when Nmecha picked up the ball on the edge of a packed penalty area and let fly. Unsighted by the thicket of bodies in front of him, the goalkeeper Daniel Batz misjudged the trajectory of the ball, and it flew over his right shoulder and into the net.
Gladbach created a number of chances, but Gregor Kobel came to the rescue with several fine saves for Dortmund, and once the goal went in, there was no way back for the hosts. Dortmund have 24 points after 10 games, two ahead of Bayern and third-placed Freiburg, who beat Elversberg 1-0.
Fourth-placed RB Leipzig had five different players on the scoresheet in a 5-1 drubbing of Union Berlin that lifted them to 21 points. Bayer Leverkusen thumped four goals without reply past Paderborn to remain fifth. Eintracht Frankfurt remained in the running for the European places thanks to a 1-0 win against Hoffenheim, with Jonathan Burkardt’s first-half goal securing the victory.
Meanwhile, Fifpro said on Saturday it was “deeply concerned” by public comments from Bayern’s leadership about Jamal Musiala’s contract, accusing the German champions of putting pressure on the midfielder while he recovers from health problems. The global players’ union was responding to recent remarks by senior Bayern officials, including honorary president Uli Hoeness, chief executive Jan-Christian Dreesen and supervisory board member Karl-Heinz Rummenigge, about Musiala’s future at the club.
Hoeness earlier this month questioned whether the 23-year-old Germany international could return to his previous level after being diagnosed with a neurological disorder. Dreesen later backed those remarks, saying Bayern would evaluate Musiala’s progress and discuss his future with his representatives. Rummenigge subsequently defended the comments, saying the club’s consideration of Musiala’s health and contract situation was both responsible and normal.
“Bayern’s honorary president, chief executive and former chief executive have all publicly questioned Musiala’s contract in quick succession,” Fifpro said in a statement. “In FIFPRO’s view, this is a coordinated strategy to put pressure on Musiala and his representatives ahead of any negotiations. A club of Bayern’s standing should know better.”
Musiala signed a contract extension with Bayern until 2030 in February last year. He has endured a difficult run of injuries and health setbacks in recent months. He broke his leg at the Club World Cup in July 2025, missed half of last season and collapsed twice within a few days in August before being diagnosed with a neurological disorder. In September, he suffered a hamstring injury.
“Bayern has a duty of care to Musiala. Across professional football, uncertainty about a player’s future can take a toll on their mental health, particularly when they are recovering from injury,” Fifpro added. “Making Musiala’s health and future a matter of public debate adds to that pressure. Any concerns about his contract should be raised privately with him and his representatives.”
Dreesen rejected suggestions that Bayern were trying to pressure Musiala. “We all hope that Jamal will be the Jamal we know again,” Dreesen said on Saturday. “He needs time to come back. We’ve said that several times now. He has to be given that time. And then we’ll see how things look at the beginning of next year.”
Dreesen added that there was no need to keep talking about Musiala’s contract. After September’s injury, Musiala returned as a substitute in Bayern’s 1-1 home draw with Cologne in the Bundesliga on Friday in which Harry Kane sustained an injury that may mean months of rehabilitation.
On Saturday, Kane said he was looking to come back improved for “the business end of the season”. Kane tore a ligament in his left ankle and Bayern said the Ballon d’Or winner had undergone “successful surgery overnight” having earlier said that Kane would be out for “the next few months”.
Kane posted a photo on Instagram of himself smiling broadly, while sitting on a hospital bed after the surgery, with his leg encased in a medical boot. “The highs and lows of life!” the 33-year-old wrote. “Obviously very disappointed to get this injury but as always it’s an opportunity to show resilience and improvement going into 2027. I’ll be back fresh and ready to go for the business end of the season.”
- This story will be updated

מחזור משחקים פורה באירופה כלל את ניצחונה של לאציו 3-0 על לצ'ה משערים של טיג'אני נוזלין ודוידה פראטסי, שהעלה אותה למקום הראשון בסרייה אה עם 32 נקודות, ארבעה פער אינטר מילאן השנייה. במקביל, קומו גברה 2-0 על קליארי וטיפסה למקום הרביעי בטבלה.

בגרמניה, בורוסיה דורטמונד ניצלה את התיקו של באיירן מינכן כדי לכבוש את פסגת הבונדסליגה בזכות ניצחון 1-0 על בורוסיה מונשנגלדבאך משער של פליקס נמצ'ה. מנגד, ארגון השחקנים העולמי Fifpro ביקר בחריפות את הנהלת באיירן מינכן על התבטאויות פומביות בנוגע לחוזהו ולמצבו הבריאותי של ג'מאל מוסיאלה. בנוסף, חלוץ באיירן הארי קיין עבר בהצלחה ניתוח בעקבות קרע ברצועה בקרסול וצפוי להיעדר לתקופה ארוכה.
